features.feature: Restore executable bits on every declared package.json bin target in the staging tree before the current dist is evicted, while treating only absent targets as benign and rejecting final symlinks, non-files, and intermediate-directory symlink escapes.

Preserve the existing working dist when staging executable-bit validation fails, and keep the shared main/utils build callers on the same promoteDist path without changing build-lock or install behavior.
Commit and register the hermetic global CLI executable-bit regression, including shorthand/multiple bin declarations, missing targets, invalid target shapes, and final/intermediate symlink defenses.

Keep doctor read-only while reporting the canonical global package realpath, declared bin target mode/executability, exact remediation for drift, and the compiled runtime version or version=unknown when compiled-version probing fails.
Do not alter Codex entrypoint authority, npm link/global installation behavior, or the protected build-lock and promotion crash-safety design.
